title: One Bulb in the Front Room
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：power　|　正文 310 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 power 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① power came to our village in 1974, on a Tuesday, and the whole street stood in the road to watch it arrive. My grandmother, who had cooked over wood for sixty-one years, refused to look at the wire and called it the ② power of people who had never been cold. The river, she said, had ③ power of its own and had never needed a wire to prove it.

What the ④ power did in our house was very little for a long time: one bulb in the front room, which my father switched on for visitors. The ⑤ power to decide when it came on was my grandmother's, and she used it carefully. There was a ⑥ power cut in the first winter that lasted eleven days, and the street was darker then than it had ever been, because by then we knew what we were missing.

The government that ⑦ came to power that year had promised a station in every district, and by 1981 there were three on our river, built by engineers from a country that was then a great ⑧ power. The ⑨ power supply failed twice a year, in March and October, like a season, and my father said that a village which cannot mend its own supply has given away the oldest kind of power there is.

I became an engineer, which surprised nobody, and I have spent my life on numbers: the ⑩ power of ten, the load of a village, and the difference between what a station makes and what a village needs, which is never the figure anybody writes down.

My grandmother never used the bulb. She died in 1989 with the switch painted over, and my father said she had been the last person in the street with the power to say no to it, which is a kind of power the wire does not carry.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 力；力量；动力（natural power）
C. n. 权力；权势；支配力
D. n. 能力；本领（the power to do / of doing）
E. n. 强国；大国（a great power）
F. 固定搭配：come to power 上台；开始执政
G. 固定搭配：power supply / power cut 供电／停电
H. n.[C] 幂；乘方（the power of ten）

items.q: The power came to our village in 1974
the power of people who had never been cold
The river, she said, had power of its own
What the power did in our house
The power to decide when it came on
There was a power cut in the first winter
The government that came to power that year
a country that was then a great power
The power supply failed twice a year

answers.why: the power 指“电、电力”，1974 年村里通电，全村人站在路上看它到来。
the power of ... 意为“……的权势、支配力”，祖母说这是没挨过冻的人的权力。
power 意为“力量、动力”，祖母说河本身就有力量，不需要电线来证明。
the power 指“电力”，电进我家后很长时间只做了一件事：点亮一只灯泡。
the power to do 意为“做某事的权力／能力”，此处指决定何时开灯的权力在祖母手里。
a power cut 意为“停电”，第一个冬天停了十一天。
come to power 意为“上台、开始执政”，说那年上台的政府承诺每个区建一座电站。
a great power 意为“强国、大国”，说工程队来自当时一个强国。
power supply 意为“供电”，说供电一年坏两次，像季节一样准。
the power of ten 意为“十的幂”，我当工程师后成天与数字打交道。
